notes: Passkeys: new right-click Create / Check / Delete All Pass Key under Recovery Password mail, a Passkey column that holds the account's own key, and auto sign-in with a saved passkey wherever Facebook asks for one - login 2FA, unlock, 956 and checkpoint, in m, web, emulator and Page mode - with no code and no browser dialog, falling back to the code path when there is no passkey. After Check now reads the friend count on non-English (Chinese/Korean/Russian/Thai) profiles and never reads a 'mutual friends' count as the total. Plus name/gender capture on non-English profiles, Warm Up window-wait and unlock password-change fixes, and broken/wrong Facebook links now reported to the bug tracker.
